title: 16.24. Kusalattika, Upādānadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Akusalaṁ upādānaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naakusalo noupādāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Akusalaṁ kilesaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naakusalo nokileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe tīṇi …pe… avigate pañca.
